## EA Media Tools 2.2.1 - jaguar

### Remote predefined presets

- Packaged builds now check the repository's `presets.ini` while the splash screen is visible.
- A downloaded file must pass the same section, type, enum, and numeric-range validation as the bundled file before it can be used.
- Changed contents replace the installed file atomically. Read-only installations use a managed app-data copy instead.
- Offline starts retain the last valid managed file, or the bundled defaults when no managed copy exists.
- Custom presets remain local and are never replaced by the predefined-preset sync.

### Streaming quality

- Streaming at 1080p uses CQ 28. Existing CQ 29 for 4K and 720p and CQ 32 for Cellular remain unchanged.
- Existing target bitrate, maximum bitrate, and automatic 2x buffer rules remain unchanged.
- HEVC NVENC uses five B-frames, full-resolution multipass, a compatible 26-frame lookahead, temporal AQ, and no non-reference P-frames while retaining the fast P2 preset.

### Validation

- Added regression coverage for remote validation, cross-platform line-ending comparison, atomic replacement, and tiered quality defaults.
- Lint, native and compatibility TypeScript checks, unit tests, and production packaging.

[Review changes since v2.2.0](https://github.com/eaforlife/media-converter/compare/v2.2.0...v2.2.1).
